title: GENDER BIAS, SOCIAL BIAS AND REPRESENTATION: 70 YEARS OF BHOLLYWOOD
reasoning: The paper explicitly investigates religious representation in cinema as one of its core components. It includes research questions (RQ 6 and RQ 8) and a dedicated section (Section 9.2) analyzing the representation, perception, and distribution of various religions (Hinduism, Islam, Sikhism, etc.) in Bollywood movies using NLP techniques like word embeddings and cloze tests.
